parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` — `PlaycutMetadataMockCache.set` in `PlaycutMetadataServiceCachingTests.swift` and `EntityResolverMockCache.set` in `DiscogsAPIEntityResolverCachingTests.swift` are test-only mock cache implementations within the `Metadata` package. Per the decision rules, any cluster where even one record is test-marked warrants no-action; here both are, making this a canonical test-fixture duplication. Consolidating these into shared test infrastructure would couple two independent test suites through a shared mock, increasing fragility without production benefit.
